title: Caravan — Page 64

lines.speaker: RODNEY
lines.text: It’s a suggestion, yes.

lines.speaker: PARKES
lines.text: We’ve talked about this holiday for a year. I’ve brought my caravan all the way up here. I’ve gone to a great deal of trouble. But do I get any thanks for it? No, I’m accused of being bad- tempered. We’ve only been here a week and you want to go home. Just because of a little rain.

lines.speaker: RODNEY
lines.text: A little rain! It hasn’t stopped for five days!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Six!

lines.speaker: RODNEY
lines.text: There’s a flood out there and you expect us to sleep in it.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: erupting again

lines.speaker: PARKES
lines.text: All right! That’s it! We’ll go home. Finito. Finish. Everybody get packed up.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: PENNY can’t take anymore. She erupts.

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text: Stop it! Stop it, all of you! I can’t stand anymore! I really can’t!!

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: They are all shocked into silence. They stare at PENNY.

lines.speaker: PARKES
lines.text: Now don’t get het up, Penny.

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text: Aaaah! I can’t stand it. I’ve had it.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: To PARKES

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text: I have had it. Up to here! Do you understand? Every year for four years I have had to endure this holiday. I’ve had to put up with the heat. I hate the heat! The inconvenience, the primitive conditions, there hasn’t been a light in the shower for four years- and the caravan! Your precious caravan. Parkes, do you know I hate caravans? I hate them. Do you know what I’d like to happen, Parkes? I’d like all the drips to combine into one very big flood and I’d like the caravan to float out to sea. With all of you in it!!!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Penny, love we’re sorry....

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text: You’re sorry! Oh yes, you’re sorry. For four years I’ve had the heat, and the caravan, and the children. And Parkes! And it’s been hell! I thought this year it would be different. I thought.....with my friends here, I might at least enjoy myself.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: weeps

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text: But you’re worse. You’re far worse than the children.

lines.speaker: PARKES
lines.text: We’ll go home then.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: shouts

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text: We won’t go home! We can’t go home! It’s pouring with rain! We have talked about this holiday for years. We’re here and we are stuck with it, and I insist that we stay. We have one week to go...
